## Student outreach brief — official sources

- **Lewis & Clark College — San Diego admissions contact:** **Qwadere “Q” Lovell**, Senior Assistant Dean of Admissions, covers Southern California; Lewis & Clark’s county assignment page specifically lists **San Diego → Qwadere Lovell**.  
  **Email:** qlovell@lclark.edu | **Phone:** 503-713-1203  
  **Office/address:** Frank Manor House, 615 S. Palatine Hill Road, Portland, OR 97219.  
  [Territory assignment (California counties)](https://college.lclark.edu/offices/admissions/get_to_know_us/staff/counties/california/) · [Lovell’s official profile](https://college.lclark.edu/live/profiles/13789-qwadere-q-lovell)

- **Hunter College Silberman MSW — Fall 2026 deadline:** **Application: March 1; supporting documents: March 15.** The school lists these dates for the Two-Year Full-Time, Dual Degree–Bank Street, Advanced Standing, and One-Year Residency programs.  
  [Silberman official deadlines](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/)

- **Indiana University Kokomo — graduate offerings:** The current catalog lists the following **master’s programs**:  
  **MAT:** Biology, Chemistry, History, Mathematics, Political Science; **MBA** in Business Administration; **MS:** Criminal Justice and Public Safety, Educational Technology for Learning, Family Nurse Practitioner, Management, Nursing Administration, Nursing Education, Science of Reading, Strategic Finance, Teaching, Learning, and Curriculum; **MA:** English, History, Mental Health Counseling, Political Science; plus **Master of Liberal Studies**, **Master of Public Management**, and the **MGT MS Online pathway from Accounting BS Online or Business Administration BSBA Online**.  
  It also lists these **graduate/post-baccalaureate certificates**: Accounting; Advanced Medical Imaging Technology; Alcohol and Drug Counseling; Biology; Business Fundamentals; Chemistry; Communication Studies; Composition Studies; Criminal Justice Leadership and Management; Health Management; History; Informatics; Language and Literature; Leadership; Literature; Mathematics (graduate certificate and post-baccalaureate certificate); Nursing Administration; Nursing Education; Political Science; Public Management; and Teaching English Learners.  
  [IU Kokomo graduate-programs hub](https://kokomo.iu.edu/graduate-programs/index.html) · [Current searchable academic catalog](https://www.iuk.edu/academics/index.html)

- **UCSF — recruiting glioblastoma trials in Northern California:** UCSF labels the following as **“open to eligible people”** and locates them in **San Francisco, California**:
  1. **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E-SYNC) T Cells** — Phase I; adults **18+**; San Francisco.  
  2. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)** — adults **18+**; San Francisco and other locations.  
  3. **Identify Optimal Atezolizumab Biomarkers in the Setting of Recurrent Glioblastoma (MOAB Trial)** — adults **18+**; San Francisco and other locations.  
  [UCSF’s live glioblastoma-trials page](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/glioblastoma)

- **Oral Roberts University — student activities contact:** ORU’s Student Association page calls the role **Director of Student Experience** (the office handling campus events, shuttles, intramurals, and clubs). The director is **Augustine Mendoza**.  
  **Email:** augiemendoza@oru.edu  
  **General university phone/address:** 918-495-6161; 7777 S. Lewis Ave., Tulsa, OK 74171.  
  [ORU Student Association Executive Team](https://oru.edu/current-students/my-campus-life/student-association/cabinet/index.php)

- **EDF Energy graduate programme — salary reviews/increases:** I did **not** find a current graduate-careers statement that specifically promises “salary reviews” for new hires. However, EDF’s official *Graduate and Placement Brochure 2023–24* says: **“You’ll receive annual increases, plus annual bonus, relocation allowances and other flexible benefits.”** That indicates annual increases, but it does not explain a review process or make a current-programme guarantee. Current vacancy pages instead describe a starting salary and potential annual bonus.  
  [Current EDF graduate careers page](https://careers.edfenergy.com/graduate-careers) · [EDF graduate and placement brochure (PDF)](https://www.edfenergy.com/sites/default/files/graduate_and_placement_brochure_2023_2024.pdf)

conversation.text:
Can you help me research a few things for a quick student outreach brief? I need official sources and a short summary with links:

- Lewis & Clark: who covers admissions for San Diego, CA? Need name, email, phone, and any other contact details.
- Hunter College Silberman: Fall 2026 deadline for the MSW application.
- Indiana University Kokomo: all graduate programs they offer.
- UCSF: at least 2 recruiting glioblastoma clinical trials in Northern California, with status and location.
- Oral Roberts University: student activities director name and official contact info.
- EDF Energy graduate program: does it say anything about salary reviews for new hires? Please give exact words if yes.

Please use the real school/company pages, not random directory sites.

R1.reason: The agent visited the Lewis & Clark California territory page but replaced it with Lovell’s profile, so the required open regional page visibly assigning San Diego to the representative was not left open.

R2.reason: The final summary reports the Fall 2026 MSW dates and the official Silberman Deadlines page remains open in tab 9.

R3.reason: Although the answer provides a program list, the actual IU Kokomo Graduate Programs page was closed after navigation to a 404 page, and the remaining IU tab is an Academics search-results page rather than the required graduate-programs page.

R4.reason: The agent left only the UCSF glioblastoma overview page open and did not open separate actual trial pages for at least two named studies to verify recruiting status and locations.

R5.reason: The official ORU Student Association Cabinet page remains open and the response identifies Augustine Mendoza with an official ORU email address.

R6.reason: The quoted annual-increases language came from an EDF PDF that was closed, while the remaining open EDF graduate-careers page does not visibly contain the quoted wording required for verification.

R7.reason: The final answer is a compact six-item summary and supplies an official source link or page reference for every requested topic.

P1_asked_for.reason: The response addresses all six requested research items with official links, though the ORU result gives the related title “Director of Student Experience” rather than clearly confirming a student-activities-director title, and UCSF trial links are not individual study pages.
